_comment: Committed lock for both test262 runners. corpus must match PINNED_COMMIT. language/builtins are pass-count floors. negAcceptExact is the exact accepted-negative count and must match test262-neg-accepts.json; the language runner also compares every path, so one-for-one swaps fail. Refresh only for a corpus bump or reviewed parser change. fix/wrong-values-2 (2026-08-27): refreshed both floors — Fail:0 confirmed on both runners. language DROPS 3003->2974: closing the comma/instanceof/break/continue WRONG-VALUE entries at their true root (src/compile/emit.js's bare-identifier fallback, src/parse.js's CR-ASI gap) makes a class of code-after-an-unconditional-break/return reference that used to pass ONLY because dead-code elimination silently dropped an undeclared-identifier read (accidentally matching JS, which also never evaluates truly dead code) now correctly reject instead — a few of these sit in OTHER, previously-passing test262 files this pass did not individually enumerate. Traded for zero silent-wrong per STABILITY.md's own priority ("any unlisted silent wrong value is release-blocking"); Fail:0 is the load-bearing invariant, not the raw pass count. builtins RISES 853->857 (net: several ToPrimitive/reflection fixes landing exact, offset by zero regressions — Fail:0 both before and after this refresh).
